title: Time Management and Stress Control
overview: The goal of this course is to enhance participants' efficiency and effectiveness in life management. Through interactive sessions, participants will delve into various time management skills and stress management techniques, empowering them to gain better control and make a positive impact on their professional and social lives
audience: This course is tailored for managers, supervisors, and employees seeking to enhance their time management and stress reduction skills to improve their overall performance at work and in life
methodology: This course is built on engaging interactions between the consultant and participants, incorporating a range of diagnostic tools, practical exercises, and group activities
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Identify challenges in time management and evaluate personal efficiency in time management
Explain the components of the Time Mastery Profile® and utilize them for improved time management
Apply global personal effectiveness guidelines to enhance success in both work and life
Analyze stress symptoms and their causes to identify their negative impact on mental and physical well-being
Implement stress management techniques to alleviate stress and promote a healthier and improved lifestyle
